venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CC ATL — Wednesday 8/5.** MOD MKZ/JK, entered by JK. Net $938 vs target $1,428 (-34.3%); food $105; comps $36.65 (Community Investor, Industry Love, O4W, F&F); 30 guests at $31.26 avg. Slow start with storms around open; quiet 8-9pm, small pop around 10pm with bar lined and a couple of booths sat. New hire Jayden's training shift: garnish prep, bar open, menu cocktails in detail with taste testing, made supervised menu cocktails for guests. Sysco order to be placed tomorrow; batches need topping off heading into the weekend. Kitchen quiet. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Favorite moment: investor Chris Havrilla's first visit to CC ATL with friend Alexis.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CC NSH — Wednesday 8/5.** MOD KK & MD / Chef JMS, entered by BC. Net $1,244 vs target $1,343 (-7.4%); food $131; comps $91.90 / 7.4% (Bingo credits, industry, residents); 50 guests at $24.88 avg. Decent but slower-than-recent Wednesday; first guests 4:40pm, >12 concurrent most of the night, highest volume ~9:45pm-close. Bingo couple returned to spend credits; Cauponor friends-and-family service next door brought semi-regulars over. Industry guests throughout (Soho House, Fishmonger, Groceries Etc., The Optimist, Babychan). Kitchen smooth; low on tonic. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Favorite moment: curious young baristas stayed for several rounds of cocktail questions.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Wednesday 8/5.** AM MOD Maggie S & Chef Josh; PM MOD Evan; entered by Evan. Net $10,114.32 vs target $11,291 (-10.4%); food $2,506.50; comps $266 (~2.63%); 215 guests (Tock). DC/AM $837.90; D&C PM $9,276.42; Garden/6A $513.97 (flagged as possibly wrong by MOD). Pretty chill night with a decent pop later; a few larger groups, lots of dates, friendly faces. Garden: chill solo day, cleaning, nice pop the last hour. Kitchen: a bit steady but chill (Nate). No events. Break makeup complete; no-shows not charged; no incidents. Favorite moments: Georgian wine tasting, staff connections, guests spending well.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Wednesday 8/5.** MOD Julian & Chef Saleh, entered by Julian Catano. Net $2,776 vs target $5,057 (-45.1%); all Marquee (Standing Room $0); food $445; comps/discounts $88.80 (industry, employee); 73 guests (reported check average $72.55 per report; $38.03 net/guest). Slow start, picked up a little in late dinner hours. One server (Xavier) held the floor solo and killed it; Analise crushed her second shift; new host training. Kitchen: Saleh handled it like a pro. Low rockfish, 86 trout roe. No incidents; no-shows charged. Favorite moment: a bunch of new D&C faces, same vibes.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Wednesday 8/5.** MOD Marcus. Net $3,096.28 vs target $4,118 (-24.8%); Marquee bar sales $3,420.03; food $303.30; comps $35.74 (community members); 82 guests (64 walk-in / 18 resos), GCA $40.21 / CA $99.88. Slower start, gradual build with the biggest push ~8:30pm and a second wave ~9:30pm. Community members Michael Wyble and David Kaniss in; David offered an espresso machine (following up). Heat likely dampened early foot traffic. Fixed lodged sink stopper in first-floor restroom. Cosmic Dance Break batch presenting overly tart/tannic — investigating; serving a la minute meanwhile. Cut host ~8pm on the slow start. Kitchen slower; James ran food and touched tables. Needs: cooling for entrance/garden/stairwell. No incidents; no-shows not charged.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.weather: Hot and clear, no afternoon storm
venues.narrative: **MG — Wednesday 8/5.** AM MOD Braden & Chef Lex; PM MOD James & Chef Drew; entered by James. Net $3,420 vs target $4,500 (-24.0%); food $1,767; comps $95; 64 guests (17 AM / 47 PM, OpenTable). Municipal Bar AM $1,441; PM $1,979; Sun Club $120; Hot Eye closed. Slow midweek morning — one server until 3pm due to a call-out, with Braden and Sam B. covering floor. Slow evening except Matt's fairly full, active bar; Kaylee a big help; smooth, routine night. Sun Club very slow — a few drinks and chicken sandwiches. Kitchen smooth, no wonky ticket times. Nothing urgent on maintenance. No incidents. Favorite moment: lots of locals and familiar faces, and a lot of birthdays this week.
